outcome: medication use patterns (e.g., anti-bacterials, anti-inflammatories, analgesics, COVID-19-specific medications)
cohort: Women aged 12-55 years with documented live-birth deliveries who had at least one qualifying diagnosis for COVID-19 or a positive-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 test, identified from the Sentinel Distributed Database from 2020 to 2022.
finding: Selected medication utilization was higher post-COVID-19 among pregnancies with COVID-19 compared to those without COVID-19 and non-pregnancy episodes with COVID-19, notably with low use of COVID-19-specific medications in pregnant women.
